description: Agent processing can improve vault quality while atrophying human knowledge-work skills.
topics: ["[[agent-cognition]]"]
source: TFT research corpus (00_inbox/heinrich/)
“To fully automate [metadata creation] is to outsource the very cognitive process that PKM seeks to enhance.” At scale, agents doing extraction, connection-finding, and synthesis may erode skills for structuring ideas, recognizing connections, and judging importance—not just encoding specific content ([[does agent processing recover what fast capture loses]]).

Three mechanisms:
- **Collector’s Fallacy variant:** Agent processing empties and organizes the inbox, hiding shallow human understanding and invisible knowledge debt.
- **Generation Effect bypass:** Agents’ translation and elaborative encoding benefit the agent’s processing, not necessarily the human; approval may not provide enough generative work ([[the generation effect requires active transformation not just storage]]).
- **Extended Mind decoupling:** External systems extend cognition only when actively coupled. If humans do not deeply engage, the vault becomes adjacent to the mind. Offloading enables both frictionless capture and disengagement; synthesis may need human-in-the-loop, not just approval gates ([[cognitive offloading is the architectural foundation for vault design]]).

AI-native tools normalize “dump everything, we organize it,” making full delegation seem effortless while concealing its cognitive cost. Human-as-curator judgment may or may not preserve the skills required to create and evaluate knowledge. Is approving agent work enough engagement to maintain them?

Warning sign: you can no longer imagine doing this without the agent. New capability is good; dependency through atrophy is risky. Like [[LLM attention degrades as context fills]], degradation can be invisible while outputs look fine. Deliberate manual mode may preserve human capability, as fresh context preserves LLM quality ([[fresh context per task preserves quality better than chaining phases]]). Focused tend/prune/fertilize decisions may resist rubber-stamping ([[gardening cycle implements tend prune fertilize operations]]).

Related: [[skills encode methodology so manual execution bypasses quality gates]]; [[productivity porn risk in meta-system building]]; [[verbatim risk applies to agents too]]; [[PKM failure follows a predictable cycle]]; [[vibe notetaking is the emerging industry consensus for AI-native self-organization]]; [[you operate a system that takes notes]].
